checks.environment: TMPDIR=/dev/shm avoids error -122 in default temporary-cache storage

visualReview.chunkCoverage: visibility cycling with retained caches, plus full destruction/rebuild on save load; no physical cache eviction

performance.investigationThreshold: median increase over both 10 percent and 5 ms

limitations: Representative visual scenes use seed 42; numeric preservation covers all four captured worlds.
Historical generator versions are load-only; this build generates version 10.
Diagnostic traces are bounded and transient; static explanations do not replay actor recovery or woodland density/spacing.
No GPU, maximum-map diagnostic-heap, or physical chunk-eviction measurement.
Later landform, watercourse, permanent-pond, woodland-distribution and artwork changes remain out of scope.
